Correction candidates: (1) s110 אָתָּה (qamats under alef) → אַתָּה. (2) s113 'after which you go astray Thus' → add a period: 'astray. Thus'. (3) s112 וְלֹא תָתוּרוּ has no maqaf where the Masoretic text has וְלֹֽא־תָת֜וּרוּ. This is a possible source omission; confirm before correcting.

English has no counterpart for two Hebrew rubrics: the rubric יחיד אומר אל מלך נאמן on s110, and the בלחש rubric before ברוך שם. The English has no counterpart for the rubric on joining אלהיכם to אמת on s112 either.

The parenthetical Shabbat alternative on s108 (in קשוב קול תקיעה, marked בשבת) and its English counterpart on s109 ('(heed the memory … this day)') are in the Ofan piyyut, which comes before Ahavah Rabbah and so is outside scope.
